expect_red: the suggestion colour IS the shared accent -- one declaration in apps/viewer/style.css, not a hex typed twice

mutations.contract: The suggestion overlay is the shared accent -- one declaration, in apps/viewer/style.css's :root. Red, amber and green mean provenance and a verdict in both apps (docs/DESIGN_TYPE_AND_COLOUR.md), and a candidacy is neither of those.
mutations.note: The mutation paints candidates in the provenance palette's traced green, which is the specific way this goes wrong: green reads as 'this one is right' on a surface whose whole point is that the reader decides. It also leaves the hex a plausible-looking literal, which is why the guard pairs it against the stylesheet rather than against a value written down twice.
